Name: Smart_RFL
Description: Will create a fancy RFL system for current Feet

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Will create a fancy RFL system for current Feet.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- AltMode: choose Original, SCL, or SN. Original keeps the classic Smart RFL behavior, SCL matches the legacy Alt Mode, and SN uses the alternate setup with RY behaving like PivotBallFloor.
- TransferAttrs: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- SetRFLAttrsPosition: set the node/object name this block should use.
- SetFootBlockName: set the foot block base name this block should use for SCL and SN.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
